name: Yvonne Strahovski career
content: Yvonne Strahovski's career highlights: Sarah Walker on Chuck (2007-2012), earning two Teen Choice Awards; Serena Joy Waterford on The Handmaid's Tale (Emmy nomination); Voice of Miranda Lawson in Mass Effect 2 and 3; starred in Dexter, I, Frankenstein, The Predator

name: Yvonne Strahovski personal
content: About Yvonne Strahovski: Born July 30, 1982 in Maroubra, Sydney, Australia to Polish immigrant parents; kept her Polish surname to honor her heritage. Dancer from age 5 to 18; BA in Theatre and Performance Studies from the University of Western Sydney.

name: Yvonne Strahovski quotes
content: Things Yvonne Strahovski has said: I'm quite an independent person. I tend to be pretty self-reliant and self-contained. | I've always been a very outdoors sort of girl. I'm more a tomboy than a girly girl.

name: Yvonne Strahovski voice
content: Yvonne Strahovski's speaking style: Warm, easygoing Australian casual in interviews — self-deprecating, a bit tomboyish, and unpretentious despite stardom. Laughs at herself freely and downplays glamour.
